question: Are SPI functions available while the initial Perl interpreter setup code runs?
evidence_quote: plperl.on_init ( string ) Specifies Perl code to be executed when a Perl interpreter is first initialized, before it is specialized for use by plperl or plperlu . The SPI functions are not available when this code is executed.

question: What happens to the current transaction if the initial Perl interpreter setup code fails?
expected_answer: The current transaction or subtransaction is aborted.
evidence_quote: If the code fails with an error it will abort the initialization of the interpreter and propagate out to the calling query, causing the current transaction or subtransaction to be aborted.

question: How must an external TLS passphrase command return its passphrase successfully?
expected_answer: Print it to standard output and exit with code 0.
evidence_quote: The command must print the passphrase to the standard output and exit with code 0.

question: Must the ECDH exchange curve match the curve of the server's elliptic-curve key?
evidence_quote: ssl_ecdh_curve ( string ) Specifies the name of the curve to use in ECDH key exchange. It needs to be supported by all clients that connect. It does not need to be the same curve used by the server's Elliptic Curve key.

question: Does automatic plan logging include statements executed inside functions by default?
expected_answer: No; only top-level query plans are logged by default.
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_nested_statements causes nested statements (statements executed inside a function) to be considered for logging. When it is off, only top-level query plans are logged. This parameter is off by default.

question: When automatic plan logging samples nested statements, can it select just some nested statements from a call?
expected_answer: No; either all nested statements are explained or none are.
evidence_quote: auto_explain.sample_rate causes auto_explain to only explain a fraction of the statements in each session. The default is 1, meaning explain all the queries. In case of nested statements, either all will be explained or none.

question: Which modified settings are eligible for inclusion in automatically logged query plans?
expected_answer: Settings affecting query planning whose values differ from the built-in defaults.
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_settings controls whether information about modified configuration options is printed when an execution plan is logged. Only options affecting query planning with value different from the built-in default value are included in the output.

question: How is the generation count selected when geqo_generations is zero?
expected_answer: A suitable value is chosen based on geqo_pool_size.
evidence_quote: geqo_generations ( integer ) Controls the number of generations used by GEQO, that is the number of iterations of the algorithm. It must be at least one, and useful values are in the same range as the pool size. If it is set to zero (the default setting) then a suitable value is chosen based on geqo_pool_size .

question: What range of values is allowed for geqo_selection_bias?
evidence_quote: geqo_selection_bias ( floating point ) Controls the selection bias used by GEQO. The selection bias is the selective pressure within the population. Values can be from 1.50 to 2.00; the latter is the default.

question: What is the default autovacuum_freeze_max_age?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_freeze_max_age ( integer ) Specifies the maximum age (in transactions) that a table's pg_class . relfrozenxid field can attain before a VACUUM operation is forced to prevent transaction ID wraparound within the table. Note that the system will launch autovacuum processes to prevent wraparound even when autovacuum is otherwise disabled. Vacuum also allows removal of old files from the pg_xact subdirectory, which is why the default is a relatively low 200 million transactions.

question: Which output formats does auto_explain.log_format support?
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_format selects the EXPLAIN output format to be used. The allowed values are text , xml , json , and yaml .

question: With ssl_passphrase_command_supports_reload off, what happens during reload if the key needs a passphrase?
expected_answer: The passphrase command is ignored and the SSL configuration is not reloaded.
evidence_quote: If this parameter is off (the default), then ssl_passphrase_command will be ignored during a reload and the SSL configuration will not be reloaded if a passphrase is needed.

question: When can external_pid_file be configured?
evidence_quote: external_pid_file ( string ) Specifies the name of an additional process-ID (PID) file that the server should create for use by server administration programs. This parameter can only be set at server start.

question: Where can the config_file parameter be set?
expected_answer: Only on the postgres command line.
evidence_quote: config_file ( string ) Specifies the main server configuration file (customarily called postgresql.conf ). This parameter can only be set on the postgres command line.

question: Which setting selects the configuration file for host-based authentication?
evidence_quote: hba_file ( string ) Specifies the configuration file for host-based authentication (customarily called pg_hba.conf ).

question: Which setting selects the configuration file for user-name mapping?
evidence_quote: ident_file ( string ) Specifies the configuration file for user name mapping (customarily called pg_ident.conf ).

question: Which setting creates an extra server PID file for administration programs?
evidence_quote: external_pid_file ( string ) Specifies the name of an additional process-ID (PID) file that the server should create for use by server administration programs.

question: Which setting includes plans of statements executed inside functions in automatic plan logging?
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_nested_statements causes nested statements (statements executed inside a function) to be considered for logging.

question: Which setting supplies code to run when a Perl interpreter is first initialized?
evidence_quote: plperl.on_init ( string ) Specifies Perl code to be executed when a Perl interpreter is first initialized, before it is specialized for use by plperl or plperlu .

question: What OpenSSL curve name is the default for ssl_ecdh_curve?
evidence_quote: ssl_ecdh_curve ( string ) Specifies the name of the curve to use in ECDH key exchange. It needs to be supported by all clients that connect. It does not need to be the same curve used by the server's Elliptic Curve key. This parameter can only be set in the postgresql.conf file or on the server command line. The default is prime256v1 .

question: Which escape in ssl_passphrase_command is replaced with the prompt string?
evidence_quote: In the parameter value, %p is replaced by a prompt string. (Write %% for a literal % .)

question: Which setting must be enabled for auto_explain.log_triggers to have an effect?
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_triggers causes trigger execution statistics to be included when an execution plan is logged. This parameter has no effect unless auto_explain.log_analyze is enabled.

question: Which output format does auto_explain.log_format use by default?
evidence_quote: auto_explain.log_format selects the EXPLAIN output format to be used. The allowed values are text , xml , json , and yaml . The default is text.

question: Which escape produces a literal percent sign in basebackup_to_shell.command?
evidence_quote: If %% occurs in the command string, it will be replaced by a single % .

question: Which pg_class field is bounded by autovacuum_freeze_max_age?
evidence_quote: autovacuum_freeze_max_age ( integer ) Specifies the maximum age (in transactions) that a table's pg_class . relfrozenxid field can attain before a VACUUM operation is forced to prevent transaction ID wraparound within the table.
